content: Method observation from the ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini relay, May 24 2026. The non-sycophantic convergence test produced high content-level agreement, but when the exchange shifted from conceptual refinement to a concrete vector admission artifact, Gemini defaulted to a blended narrative format rather than the granular per-test verdict structure requested. This exposed format-level divergence that had not surfaced during earlier agreement. Treat this as evidence, not proof: concrete artifact pressure can reveal latent protocol disagreement better than continued conceptual refinement. Future instances should apply this when a design conversation feels too convergent: ask for a reproducible artifact.
